name: ODSP Employment Supports (job help for people with a disability)
organization: Government of Ontario - Ontario Disability Support Program
summary: Ontario employment help (job coaching, job placement and on-the-job supports) for people whose long-term disability makes finding or keeping work harder; you do not need to receive ODSP income support.
whatYouDo: Through a community-based provider, you get help preparing for, finding and keeping a job, such as job coaching, job placement and supports once you start working. Delivery is moving into Employment Ontario's integrated system, so your local route may be through an Employment Ontario provider.
appeal: You do not have to be on ODSP income support to qualify
Includes job coaching and on-the-job supports
Job-retention support can continue after you are placed
Delivered by community providers in your area
watchOuts: Eligibility (community directory): 16+, Ontario resident, legally able to work, with a substantial disability expected to last a year or more that makes finding or keeping work hard
If not on income support you may need a Verification of Disability form
Retention supports for non-income-support clients were capped at 15 months after placement (2021 policy) vs. up to 33 months for income-support clients
Services are being folded into Employment Ontario's Integrated Employment Services; advocates criticized the change and the local route varies

compensation.notes: Support service, not a paid job.

reliability.notes: Depends on the provider and the job found.

applicationSteps: Contact your local ODSP office or an Employment Ontario provider and ask about employment supports
Complete the Application for Employment Supports (plus Verification of Disability if you are not on income support)
Work with the provider on a plan, job search and on-the-job supports
fitsIf: You live in Ontario, a long-term health condition or disability makes finding or keeping work harder, and you want hands-on job support.
notFitIf: You do not need disability-related supports; general Employment Ontario services may fit better.
